info.title: La Lassaura Phase 01 API review draft
info.description: Phase 01 review contract with live subset marked x-implemented. Live booking routes use same-origin Laravel session and CSRF. Other operations remain proposed. Booking route identifiers are UUID references; room input uses the public slug. Multi-room booking is still deferred.
